# Arcit snapshot

Copied without source changes from
`~/arc/arcadia/devtools/emacs/plugins/arcit/arcit.el` on 2026-11-15.
The adjacent compiled file was built with MacPorts Emacs 31.1.
Dependencies are installed in `../../elpa/` and declared in Arcit's header.

The snapshot keeps this configuration reproducible and avoids load-time
obsolete-macro warnings from loading the source on Emacs 31.
